checks.name: source_audit
checks.details: complete panel, regular interval, normal-only labels, finite uniform-dtype features; 0 pre-existing temperature-summary violations recorded

checks.name: split_boundaries_and_purge
checks.details: 3 chronological partitions, 30-timestamp purge gaps, no shared rows or timestamps

checks.name: host_pool_separation
checks.details: anomaly hosts are disjoint across supervised_train / validation / test (every host still appears as normal data in every partition)

checks.name: normal_train_preserved
checks.details: 518,400 rows, all labels 0, every source column identical to the source rows

checks.name: supervised_copy_integrity
checks.details: same 518,400 rows/order as normal train; only the 6,902 labelled rows differ

checks.name: label_consistency
checks.details: label, anomaly_type and event_id agree in all three labelled datasets

checks.name: event_manifest_matches_data
checks.details: 360 events: labelled rows equal hosts x window for every event

checks.name: event_parameters_and_placement
checks.details: counts, durations, host counts, band ranges, edge margins and overlap/guard rules all respected

checks.name: realized_effects
checks.details: every event re-measured on the final frames: correct direction/magnitude, unrelated features and unlabelled rows unchanged, every labelled row changed, manifest values match

checks.name: schema_dtype_finite
checks.details: identical columns/dtypes in all 4 datasets; 28 finite float32 features

checks.name: temperature_summary_no_new_violations
checks.details: no new min<=mean<=max violations (pre-existing source violations are recorded, not altered)

checks.name: held_out_separation
checks.details: held-out events appear only in test; no other event has parameters inside a held-out range

checks.name: plan_reproducibility
checks.details: event plan re-derived from the seed is identical (full-content determinism is covered by the test suite)

checks.name: capacity_feasibility
checks.details: all configured events were placed without shortening or dropping

checks.name: artifacts_readback
checks.details: parquet files and event manifests re-read identical to memory
